purpose: Compare frozen CoverageDLGN Legacy V4 against the original fixed-random topology on the identical nine-channel LogicTreeNet-M architecture through 200,000 updates.

architecture.input_encoding: three fixed uniform thermometer thresholds per RGB channel; nine Boolean channels

matched_training.residual_initialization: probability 0.951, corresponding to paper z3 approximately 5

logging.validation_history: metrics.csv records loss, hardened and relaxed validation accuracy every 2000 updates
logging.threshold_history: thresholds.csv records input thresholds every 2000 updates
logging.topology_diagnostics: topology.json/csv and conv_topology.json/csv are written at initialization
logging.reproducibility: training_config.json and environment.json are written at initialization
logging.checkpoint_selection: best_checkpoint.pt and best_model.pt track the best hardened-validation checkpoint

stop_and_test_policy: The already-running V4 job was originally frozen for 350,000 updates; it will be interrupted only after its completed 200,000-step validation and checkpoint write are observed.
The random control terminates normally at exactly 200,000 updates.
The held-out test set remained unused until both methods completed and their best hardened-validation checkpoints were SHA-256 frozen; each selected checkpoint was then evaluated exactly once.
The training harness does not save optimizer, data-loader, or RNG state, so an interrupted V4 trajectory cannot later be resumed exactly.
comparison_scope: The topology rule is the only intended method difference. Coverage-only candidate-pool, swap-fraction, and novelty fields remain in the random JSON for configuration-shape parity but are ignored by the random topology generator.

paired_outcome.interpretation: Positive one-seed result; insufficient for a statistical paper claim.
